title: mail: Email/set destroy stub (immutability guard)
description:
Implement Email/set destroy in Email/set handler: always return notPermitted setError for every requested id. Articles are immutable in v1; deletion is not supported. Log attempt at WARN level.

Why: JMAP clients may send destroy requests (e.g., move-to-trash); the server must reject these with the correct error code rather than silently ignoring or crashing.

Acceptance: Email/set destroy for any id returns {type: notPermitted} in the not-destroyed map.
